Implemented Capabilities

Available Services & Modules

All modules listed below are implemented and active in the current MVP service.

01 Implemented

Roles & Permissions

Role-based access control (RBAC) catalog, granular permission definitions, and member role assignments across platform and church scopes.

/api/v1/roles
02 Implemented

Authentication & Sessions

Member registration, OTP account verification, JWT access & refresh tokens, password recovery, session management, and account deactivation.

/api/v1/auth
03 Implemented

Members & Profiles

Member profile management, field-level privacy controls, church affiliation updates, social links, and suspension or reinstatement workflows.

/api/v1/members
04 Implemented

Churches & Affiliation

Congregation directory, state and LGA location listings, geographic map coordinates, and church administration starting from Mkar National HQ.

/api/v1/churches
05 Implemented

Membership Verification

4-pathway membership verification requests, member acknowledgements, approval and rejection review queues, and direct administrative validation.

/api/v1/verification
06 Implemented

Posts & Moderation

Community feed, posts, comments, reactions, shares, member content reports, moderation queues, and moderation audit history.

/api/v1/posts
07 Implemented

Groups

Community groups, membership join/leave flows, join request reviews, invitations, and group leadership promotion or removal.

/api/v1/groups
08 Implemented

Church Galleries

Congregation photo albums, media photo submissions, and moderator review queues for church gallery curation.

/api/v1/gallery
09 Implemented

Resources & Central Library

Central and personal digital libraries, resource authoring and submission, editorial review queues, downloads, and archiving.

/api/v1/resources
10 Implemented

Non-Financial Marketplace

Seller access governance, listings, order requests, fulfilment pool coordination, and order messaging without in-app financial settlement.

/api/v1/marketplace
11 Implemented

Announcements, Recitations & Notifications

Official church announcements, recitation publishing controls, in-app notifications, read states, device tokens, and notification preferences.

/api/v1/communication
12 Implemented

Admin Counts & Audit Trail

Platform-wide administrative counts, immutable system audit logs, and moderation action records for governance oversight.

/api/v1/audit
